title: NeoRadar zones dataset
description: datasets/zones.geojson: tagged polygons the client tests every aircraft against on each position batch. A zone carries one or more free-text tags; the client never enumerates them, it only publishes which tags contain each target as the zoneTags expression (the matching tags, distinct, sorted, space-separated) and how many zones do as zoneCount. Stand areas, runway strips, aprons, de-icing pads and works areas are all just tags a package chooses. Coordinates are EPSG:3857 metres like every other GeoJSON in datasets/, so the same file can also be listed in the manifest's mapLayers and drawn; a file whose coordinates all fit inside longitude/latitude degree ranges is refused as WGS84 rather than loaded in the wrong place. Absent file means no zones: zoneTags is empty and zoneCount is 0 for every target.

name.description: Free text; GIS exporters write the layer name here.

crs.description: Tolerated for GIS exporters that write one. Ignored by the client: the coordinates are always EPSG:3857.

position.description: [x, y] in EPSG:3857 metres. A third element is tolerated and ignored.

ring.description: A closed linear ring: first and last position equal, at least four positions.

coordinates.description: The outer ring first, then any holes.

id.description: GeoJSON feature id. The client reads properties.id and falls back to this.
Names the zone in the .dev zone-info report and in the load log. Absent falls back to the feature id, then to the feature's index in the file.

items.description: One tag: letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and dot, no spaces. The package owns the vocabulary; the client compares it case-sensitively and never interprets it. contains is a substring test on the space-joined list, so a tag that is a prefix of another (stand and stand-remote) matches both; choose tags that are not substrings of one another, or test a single-tag zone with ==.

tags.description: Every tag this zone contributes to a target inside it. A target inside several zones reads the union.

floor.description: Lowest pressure altitude in feet the zone applies at, inclusive. Absent means the surface. A below-surface report at high QNH is clamped onto the surface, as for a sector volume, so a surface zone never loses an aircraft on the ground.

ceiling.description: Highest pressure altitude in feet the zone applies at, inclusive. Absent means no upper bound.

properties.description: additionalProperties is open on purpose: a zones file listed in mapLayers carries its layer styling here too.
